summary: Exact commit d6959386c233a1fcb0d27030bc9f576ddd7ca26e is test/report-only and retains the base implementation. Both direct request-path reproduction and its own live regression show that omitted /v1/chat/completions sampling fields still override --preferred-sampling-params. The report's candidate_verified claim concerns a different commit, fc25fb0ed902605ed7aaf5592a72e42979219965, and cannot verify the reviewed candidate.

tests.what_was_measured: The imported checkout source eagerly produced temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, top_k=-1, and presence_penalty=0.0, overwriting preferred values 0.7, 0.8, 20, and 1.5.
Both candidate-added utilities are syntactically valid.
Regenerated the deterministic fixture; model.safetensors SHA256 was 1407483bbc21bd0a4f84eb72acb2eb0d4b23019e5db843029e151f348e8fe108.

tests.command: exact-candidate server with torch_native attention, disabled graphs, max-total-tokens 4096, then probe_sampling_precedence.py --expect-chat-precedence
tests.what_was_measured: GPU execution returned HTTP 200 for chat/completions, explicit/omitted requests, batching, and streaming, but omitted chat output differed from explicit-preferred output, so the candidate's original-contract assertion failed.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X with gfx950 executed the exact-candidate tiny Llama server. Logs showed weight loading, a 4096-token KV cache, prefill/decode execution, torch_native attention, cuda graph false, and HTTP 200 responses.

remaining_counterexamples: On exact commit d6959386c233a1fcb0d27030bc9f576ddd7ca26e, an omitted chat request still resolves temperature to 1.0 instead of preferred 0.7.
On exact commit d6959386c233a1fcb0d27030bc9f576ddd7ca26e, an omitted chat request still resolves top_p to 1.0 instead of preferred 0.8.
On exact commit d6959386c233a1fcb0d27030bc9f576ddd7ca26e, an omitted chat request still resolves top_k to -1 instead of preferred 20.
On exact commit d6959386c233a1fcb0d27030bc9f576ddd7ca26e, an omitted chat request still resolves presence_penalty to 0.0 instead of preferred 1.5.
The candidate's live probe returns HTTP 200 for all paths but exits 1 because omitted chat output does not match explicit preferred sampling.
remaining_limitations: Tiny random weights validate request handling and ROCm engine execution, not semantic model quality.
The candidate changed no native source, so a native rebuild was neither applicable nor performed.
Prefill and decode graph backends were disabled; graph-enabled behavior was not measured.
The first live start failed from default KV-cache over-allocation on the 288-GB device; explicit 4096-token sizing succeeded.
A non-fatal Torch Dynamo metrics serialization error occurred during warmup.
